description: Change the configuration of an existing app configuration

app_installation_id.description: ID of the app installation the configuration belongs to.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns the app configuration.

applies_to_all_projects.description: Whether the app configuration applies to all projects under the company.

applies_to_company.description: Whether the app configuration is available from company routes.

renderer.description: Renderer type for the app configuration.

manifest_url.description: Temporary presigned URL for the app's manifest.

configured_manifest_property_values.description: Configurable properties declared in the app's manifest, keyed by component type, populated with the values saved on this app configuration.

projects.description: Projects the app configuration applies to.

applies_to_all_projects.description: Whether the app configuration applies to all projects in the company. When true, project_ids is ignored.

applies_to_company.description: Whether the app configuration is available from company routes.

instance_configuration.description: Values for the configurable fields declared in the app installation's manifest.

title.description: Title of the app configuration. Must be 3-48 characters and unique within the app installation.

project_ids.description: IDs of the projects the app configuration applies to. Ignored when applies_to_all_projects is true.
